svg.title: Repository Commit Activity
svg.desc: Vigil: 22 commits, 11 active days; Potamorph: 15 commits, 3 active days. 2025-11-05 through 2026-11-04, UTC. One tile per calendar day; colored segments add to the daily total. Height is linear, 64 units at 16 commits/day. Author-filtered repository commits, not GitHub profile contributions.
